limitations: The exact universal U-threshold remains open between 1 and 1.413520; the lower obstruction does not exclude univalence; full theorem-level inspection of the 1996 polylogarithm paper was unavailable. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
provenance: A quantitative refinement of the reciprocal polylogarithmic convolution problem posed by Ali, Obradovic and Ponnusamy in 2013, using the area theorem and a starlike power-family obstruction.
record_title: A quantitative bracket for reciprocal polylogarithmic smoothing into the class U
